sql: SELECT trip_date, date_format(trip_date,'EEEE') AS weekday_name, trips, CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_target_date FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE date_format(trip_date,'yyyy-MM') = '2024-11' AND date_format(trip_date,'EEEE') = 'Thursday' ORDER BY trip_date LIMIT 500
